analysis.reasonEn: After 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see following the previous buy signal, today confirms RSI's exit from oversold at 46.4→56.4. The price at 116,975 KRW, compared to the 5-day low of 102,825 KRW, forms a Higher Low pattern, confirming a recovery signal.
